We have now given a recipe for constructing Wϑ[Λ] and µ[Λ] for any Λ > 0 and generic
ϑ. Wϑ[Λ] consists of a ﬁnite number of S-walls for any Λ. Taking the limit Λ →∞we obtain
the full Wϑ and µ. So we have now managed to determine all of the soliton degeneracies of
the theory (including their tricky signs) using only the constraint of homotopy invariance!
